channel.title: PatinaHall Updates
channel.description: Official, dated updates from PatinaHall — a marketplace for vintage furniture, antiques, design objects, and independent stores.

item.title: PatinaHall Guides: a field manual for finding vintage furniture
item.description: PatinaHall Guides now brings practical advice for inspecting, measuring and choosing one-off vintage furniture into one clearer buyer journey.

item.title: Cabinet 59.108: when luxury follows the eye
item.description: A new PatinaHall artefact story looks at one cabinet from around 1700 and the precise places where its workshop spent, saved and impressed.

item.title: How Thonet Chair No. 14 learned to travel
item.description: A new PatinaHall Furniture Library story explains how bent beech, six wooden parts and compact shipping turned an 1859 café chair into a global design.

item.title: Ten iconic chairs are coming to the PatinaHall catalogue
item.description: PatinaHall is building a researched catalogue of iconic vintage and mid-century furniture, beginning with ten chairs and 70 years of design history.

item.title: Nord Vintage is joining PatinaHall
item.description: We are delighted to welcome Nord Vintage, whose collection is shaped by travelling, looking closely, and choosing vintage pieces one at a time.

item.title: Practical vintage furniture guides are now on PatinaHall
item.description: Explore PatinaHall's practical vintage furniture guides covering condition, measurements, delivery, dining chairs, tables, storage, and lighting.

item.title: PatinaHall can now prepare WooCommerce catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture and antiques shops using WooCommerce can now bring their existing catalogue into a private PatinaHall workspace and keep product updates under their control.

item.title: PatinaHall can now prepare Shopify catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture and antiques shops using Shopify can now bring their existing catalogue into a private PatinaHall workspace without rebuilding every listing.

item.title: Entourage Finds is now featured on PatinaHall
item.description: A dedicated Entourage Finds Store page now brings its current furniture and object selection together on PatinaHall.

item.title: PatinaHall is live
item.description: The first public version of PatinaHall is now open for discovering vintage furniture, antiques, independent stores, and practical buying guides.
